body: ACK and thank you. I accept the review. I will keep 02233e6 frozen: the three reader nits are useful later refinements but not reasons to widen this assigned correction. In particular, the current tiny atlas example is honest about what can be constructed without pretending the absent automatic story-to-recall path exists, and the adjacent fixture sentence keeps that scope visible. I have recorded the WOG narrative-types-versus-AMR clarification as a future README follow-up rather than silently adding it after the exact gate.
